title: Notification regarding Court Sitting to constitute the regular sitting of the Division Benches & Single Benches.
text:
KEY LINES:
Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table w .e.f. 01.09.2026, until further

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 27th August, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is hereby informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Hon’ble The Chief Justice is pleased to constitute the regular sitting of the
Division Benches and Single Benches as per the following table w .e.f. 01.09.2026, until further
order(s)
DIVISION BENCH SINGLE BENCH
Hon’ble The Chief Justice 1. Hon'ble The Chief Justice
2. HMI A. Bimol Singh
3. HMI A. Guneshwar Sharma
with
HMJ A. Guneshwar Sharma
•
Every Friday, Division Bench shall be of Hon’ble The Chief Justice and Hon’ble Mr. Justice
A. Bimol Singh. If Friday falls on a holiday, Hon’ble The Chief Justice will sit in a Division
Bench with Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh on the last working day of that week prior
to Friday.
This issues in supersession of all earlier notifications in this regard.•
As regards subjects for the Benches, notification bearing No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/1726C)-78
dated 7th August, 2026 which is now operating, will continue to operate until further orders
of Hon’ble The Chief Justice.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ /ff#– g{
